alt: A colorful artificial coral reef diorama features a prominent purple tube sponge, pink sea fan, and various other sculpted marine life including yellow and red fish, set against a dark background.

An elaborate, multi-tiered cake sculpted to resemble a vibrant coral reef, featuring a large sea turtle perched atop the highest peak, surrounded by colorful fondant corals, starfish, and other marine life.
A vibrant underwater diorama features a textured orange starfish clinging to a rock above a cluster of pale green sea anemones with purple tips, surrounded by colorful coral and a yellow fish.
A detailed sculpture of a sea turtle with outstretched flippers perched atop a colorful coral reef base featuring pink, purple, and white corals and a small striped fish.
